# Avalon policy reference and licence notice

The historical expert-tail helper and the version 0.5 owned expert RAM policy
are fresh Rust implementations informed by `moe_hosted_tail_skip`,
`moe-arena.h`, `moe-ram-budget.h` and lazy PLE loading in freriadoc/Avalon,
commit `762a3dae8d78ff18acb38e351dfa940328485fd8`. No HIP kernel is included
or represented as a Vulkan port. Avalon attribution and its licence are
retained here for the referenced implementation.

Source: https://github.com/freriadoc/Avalon/tree/762a3dae8d78ff18acb38e351dfa940328485fd8

The surrounding RustingStrata-derived distribution remains subject to
`LICENSE.md`; this notice does not relicense it.
